en.longDescription:
Vaultwarden is a lightweight, Bitwarden-compatible password manager server written in Rust.

Set DOMAIN via SERVICE_URL_VAULTWARDEN (include https:// in production). Admin panel at /admin uses SERVICE_PASSWORD_VAULTWARDEN as ADMIN_TOKEN.

de.longDescription:
Vaultwarden ist ein leichtgewichtiger, Bitwarden-kompatibler Passwort-Manager-Server, geschrieben in Rust.

Setze DOMAIN über SERVICE_URL_VAULTWARDEN (in Produktion mit https://). Das Admin-Panel unter /admin verwendet SERVICE_PASSWORD_VAULTWARDEN als ADMIN_TOKEN.

fr.shortDescription: Gestionnaire de mots de passe auto-hébergé compatible Bitwarden
fr.longDescription:
Vaultwarden est un serveur de gestionnaire de mots de passe léger et compatible Bitwarden écrit en Rust.

Définissez DOMAIN via SERVICE_URL_VAULTWARDEN (incluez https:// en production). Le panneau admin sur /admin utilise SERVICE_PASSWORD_VAULTWARDEN comme ADMIN_TOKEN.

pt.shortDescription: Gerenciador de senhas auto-hospedado compatível com Bitwarden
pt.longDescription:
Vaultwarden é um servidor de gerenciador de senhas leve e compatível com Bitwarden, escrito em Rust.

Defina DOMAIN via SERVICE_URL_VAULTWARDEN (inclua https:// em produção). O painel admin em /admin usa SERVICE_PASSWORD_VAULTWARDEN como ADMIN_TOKEN.
